messages.subject: File browser possible for downloadHandler?
parts:
Currently downloadLink / downloadHandler functionality downloads a file to the browser's default download location.

Is it possible to bring up a file browser to choose location for the downloaded file, analogous to the way fileInput brings up a file browser?

I suspect the answer is "no, not currently possible".

In principle, might it be possible to write my own snippet of javascript to do this job?  If so, where would I put it?  I'm thinking maybe in

/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/shiny/www/shared/shiny.js

where I find

var downloadLinkOutputBinding = new OutputBinding();
  $.extend(downloadLinkOutputBinding, {
    find: function(scope) {
      return $(scope).find('a.shiny-download-link');
    },
    renderValue: function(el, data) {
      $(el).attr('href', data);
    }
  });
  outputBindings.register(downloadLinkOutputBinding, 'shiny.downloadLink');

thanks for any help!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: File browser possible for downloadHandler?
parts:
It is up to your web browser's settings. You cannot do anything in
shiny to change this behavior. Instead, you should change your
browser's settings, e.g. for Google Chrome:
https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95574?hl=en Other web
browsers should have similar settings.

Regards,
Yihui
